purpose: Agent reasoning prompts; not implementations of the scientific analyses.

annotation.question: Cell identity/state
annotation.does_not_support: Novel cell type from a cluster label

sc_composition.question: Population representation
sc_composition.supports: Relative or absolute abundance under the declared denominator

sc_expression.question: Within-state transcriptional response
sc_expression.supports: Gene-level effect in the stated contrast
sc_expression.does_not_support: Protein activity or direct mechanism from RNA alone

pathway.question: Programme coherence
pathway.does_not_support: Causal pathway action from an enrichment p-value

regulon.question: Candidate regulation
regulon.does_not_support: Every inferred edge is a direct binding event

trajectory.question: State ordering
trajectory.does_not_support: Observed lineage or elapsed time from pseudotime

spatial_mapping.question: Reference-based localization
spatial_mapping.does_not_support: Exact cell contact from mixed spots

communication.question: Candidate signaling
communication.does_not_support: Demonstrated signaling from transcript score alone

qpcr.question: Targeted transcript abundance
qpcr.does_not_support: Protein or phenotype validation by default

imaging.question: Localization/intensity/morphology
imaging.does_not_support: Direct binding from overlap or statistics from a representative panel

functional.question: Cell/tissue function
functional.supports: The function actually measured by the assay
functional.does_not_support: Assay proxy is the entire disease process

perturbation.question: Intervention consequence
perturbation.supports: Context-scoped effect under an identifying design

rescue.question: Specificity or reversal
rescue.supports: Defined rescue contrast in its system

model_prediction.question: Predictive usefulness
model_prediction.supports: Heldout task performance versus matched baselines
model_prediction.does_not_support: Benchmark success demonstrates a biological mechanism

other.question: Project-specific endpoint
other.supports: Only claims justified by explicit assay description
